scientific_question: Does the unchanged v2.4 differential evidence-admission mechanism reproduce all four registered links on fresh backbones that had no checkpoint, gain, Liu characterization, or result when the candidate equation was proposed?
current_theory: Observed support evidence feeds two causally distinct computations through different admission rules: selective effective evidence enters P_T for coherent remote/global relational assembly, whereas broader reliability-weighted weak evidence enters L_T for query-addressed direct-experience fidelity.
confirmation_hypothesis: On each fresh competent backbone, the zero-parameter local admission s_L=m_t[z_sr+(1-z_sr)p_sr] will rescue stable-omitted direct fidelity relative to shared access, preserve retained fidelity within the frozen noninferiority margin, require matched evidence and query routing, and remain nontransitive under P-off while the unchanged P_T branch preserves global competence.
claim_boundary: This is a blind two-fresh-backbone confirmation of the exact frozen v2.4 mechanism and four-link contract. Passing can promote P_T/L_T plus differential evidence admission into the working main computational model across discovery, characterized-development, and fresh-confirmation networks. It cannot establish a statistical network-population prevalence, uniquely identify the human evidence transform, prove biological memory stores, or solve the separate excessive nonlearned symbolic-distance slope.
registration_timing: Frozen after the seed-2102/2103 v2.4 pilot and before writing a confirmation runner, creating any seed-2104/2105 artifact, adapting either gain, or constructing any seed-2104/2105 Liu condition.

freshness_audit.selection_rule: The next two consecutive unused development seeds after 2103 were selected before any artifact existed. Two seeds are the minimum independent confirmation set and stay within the project one-to-three-seed development rule.
freshness_audit.pre_registration_repository_check: No path, checkpoint, gain, result, report, or prior Liu characterization containing seed-2104 or seed-2105 existed in the repository or output root.

network_seed_contract.mandatory_execution: Both fresh backbones must be trained and generic-gain-adapted before one joint artifact lock is written. Only after that lock is committed and pushed may both seeds be evaluated on Liu in one command. Seed 2104 may not determine whether seed 2105 is trained, adapted, locked, or evaluated.
network_seed_contract.no_network_population_pooling: Participant rows from different networks must never be pooled. Every link is decided separately in each seed, followed by an all-fresh-seed confirmation label.

development_seed_contract.new_backbone_training: required under the frozen v1 training contract
development_seed_contract.new_gain_adaptation: required under the frozen generic-only v2.3 adaptation contract
development_seed_contract.mandatory_execution: Both fresh backbones must receive all seven conditions after the joint artifact lock; no adaptive stopping, replacement, or checkpoint selection is allowed.

execution_sequence.protocol_freeze: Commit and push this specification before confirmation implementation or any artifact generation.
execution_sequence.implementation_freeze: Commit and push the confirmation runner, tests, and exact source lock before training either seed.
execution_sequence.artifact_generation: Train seed 2104 and seed 2105 final-step backbones and adapt both local gains using generic meta-training data only. No Liu evaluator or human outcome may run in this stage.
execution_sequence.artifact_freeze: Write, commit, and push one joint lock containing both checkpoint, configuration, manifest, backbone log, gain, and gain-log hashes before either Liu evaluation.
execution_sequence.evaluation: Evaluate all seven conditions for both seeds in one process and write the result only after both complete.
execution_sequence.adaptive_stopping_filtering_replacement_: forbidden except an integrity-only source-locked execution repair that leaves every scientific contract unchanged

runtime_contract.device: visible CUDA GPU required for backbone training, local-gain adaptation, and neural replay
runtime_contract.trial_input_transfer: one contiguous CPU-to-GPU transfer per trial
runtime_contract.checkpoint_selection: final registered step only; intermediate checkpoints are never evaluated

v1_backbone_training.held_out_graph: source-correct Liu graph and its rank-axis reflection

local_only_adaptation.backbone: Freeze every parameter of the corresponding final-step v1 backbone.
local_only_adaptation.task_distribution: The unchanged generic sparse ranking distribution with the Liu graph and rank-axis reflection excluded.
local_only_adaptation.loss: Mean generic query cross-entropy of the intact v2.3 dual branch over all 28 query pairs.
local_only_adaptation.control_training: none; every condition within seed reuses the exact frozen seed-specific lambda_L

frozen_mechanism.retained_identity: If z_sr=1, candidate and shared own writes are identical.
frozen_mechanism.omitted_weak_access: If z_sr=0, the candidate local scalar is m_t p_sr while shared access is zero.
frozen_mechanism.state_update: L_(t+1)=L_t+s_t^L k_t exactly once at support step 0, with rho=1 and omega=1
frozen_mechanism.policy: m_e=m_G,e+lambda_L ell_e with the unchanged symmetric plus/minus half-margin correction
frozen_mechanism.unchanged_components: P_T, recurrent support and query dynamics, W_out, tanh, L_T address/update/read, p_sr, z_sr, gain adaptation, and all controls
frozen_mechanism.capacity: zero new trainable or calibrated parameters

control_contract.local_off_v1: Frozen P_T global channel with zero local correction; must exactly restore v1.
control_contract.shared_access_v2_3: Frozen v2.3 s_t^L=s_t^G with the seed-specific generic-only gain.
control_contract.dual_access_matched: Registered dual-access evidence on natural support and query addresses.
control_contract.dual_access_evidence_shuffle: Within subject and support block, apply the fixed derangement of all eight signed candidate local evidence scalars across cue addresses while preserving the exact scalar multiset, global P_T, write count, timing, gain, and cue-address multiset.
control_contract.dual_access_query_shuffle: Natural candidate trace with the frozen canonical within-subject query-address derangement.
control_contract.global_P_off_shared_access: Zero P_T only during query replay while retaining shared-access L_T.
control_contract.global_P_off_dual_access: Zero P_T only during query replay while retaining natural dual-access L_T.
control_contract.LOO_semantics: Remove the source support relation from P_T and set its local evidence scalar to zero before routing; reuse the same intact maps in every LOO replay.

estimand_contract.cell_unit: Subject by learned relation by query orientation; compute correct-signed margins and exact sigmoid probabilities at T=0.25 separately by orientation before averaging.
estimand_contract.omitted_exact_rescue: Within participant average candidate-minus-shared exact probability over stable-omitted learned cells.
estimand_contract.omitted_direct_causal_rescue: For each omitted support relation, subtract relation-LOO total margins, antisymmetrize, apply the complete-graph Hodge residual projector, correct-sign the source direct edge, and average omitted relations within participant.
estimand_contract.retained_preservation: Within participant average candidate-minus-shared exact probability over retained learned cells and verify exact retained own-write identity.
estimand_contract.evidence_specificity: Pair matched candidate against evidence shuffle on omitted exact probability and omitted direct causal correctness.
estimand_contract.query_specificity: Pair matched candidate against query shuffle on omitted direct causal correctness.
estimand_contract.local_only_partition: Under P-off report exact and sampled results separately for retained, omitted, and nonlearned pairs, candidate-minus-shared omitted exact rescue, and remote collapse.
estimand_contract.mandatory_secondary_behavior: For every condition report learned, nonlearned, and overall sampled accuracy, coherent errors, symbolic-distance slope, and exact-probability slope decomposition; none is a primary v2.4 gate unless named below.
estimand_contract.global_mechanism: Report exact P_T identity, v1 qualification, fast-weight necessity, query binding, remote/third-party reassembly, and expected-rank-over-MAP projection.

competence_and_integrity_gates.source_and_artifact_hashes: Every registered and implementation source, checkpoint, configuration, manifest, gain, and training log must match its joint lock.
competence_and_integrity_gates.backbone: Each local-off/v1 backbone must pass qualification_v2 before confirmation is interpreted.
competence_and_integrity_gates.shared_access_identity: Shared-access logits, local states, exact probabilities, raw causal values, and sampled behavior must agree exactly with the v2.3 reference computed in the same locked process.
competence_and_integrity_gates.global_identity: P_T and global logits before local correction are identical across local conditions.
competence_and_integrity_gates.retained_own_write_identity: For z_sr=1, candidate and shared own writes agree within 1e-7.
competence_and_integrity_gates.omitted_source_identity: For z_sr=0, candidate local scalar equals m_t p_sr within 1e-7 using the p_sr that generated z_sr.
competence_and_integrity_gates.presentation_invariance: Support reversal leaves s_t^L k_t unchanged and query reversal negates ell_e within 1e-7.
competence_and_integrity_gates.routing_integrity: Evidence and query maps are derangements preserving their registered multisets and are reused in every intact and LOO replay.
competence_and_integrity_gates.parameter_integrity: No parameter changes during Liu replay; every condition within seed uses the same frozen backbone and lambda_L.

primary_links.omitted_direct_fidelity_rescue: Within each seed, both participant-bootstrap lower bounds for omitted candidate-minus-shared exact probability and omitted candidate-minus-shared direct causal correctness exceed zero.
primary_links.retained_fidelity_preservation: Within each seed, the participant-bootstrap lower bound for retained candidate-minus-shared exact probability is at least -0.005 and retained own-write identity passes within 1e-7.
primary_links.evidence_and_query_specificity: Within each seed, matched candidate beats evidence shuffle on omitted exact probability and omitted direct causal correctness and beats query shuffle on omitted direct causal correctness; all three paired lower bounds exceed zero.
primary_links.local_only_nontransitive_access: Within each seed under P-off, omitted exact probability lower bound exceeds 0.50, candidate-minus-shared omitted exact lower bound exceeds zero, sampled nonlearned accuracy upper bound is at most 0.55, P-off all-source remote minus 0.25 times shared-intact all-source remote upper bound is below zero, and local-off preserves every global competence gate.

cross_seed_decision.link_confirmation: A link confirms only if its complete within-seed rule passes independently in both fresh seeds 2104 and 2105.
cross_seed_decision.all_links_confirm: Promote P_T/L_T plus differential evidence admission into the working main computational model while retaining exact scope and remaining negatives.
cross_seed_decision.heterogeneous_or_unresolved: If a link passes in only one fresh seed, label it heterogeneous_or_unresolved; do not pool participants, replace a seed, change a threshold, or average into a pass.
cross_seed_decision.valid_omitted_rescue_without_specificity: Reject the differential-routing interpretation if rescue occurs without matched evidence/query specificity.
cross_seed_decision.valid_rescue_with_retained_harm: Reject this admission rule as a main model if retained noninferiority fails, even if omitted cells improve.
cross_seed_decision.valid_local_only_globalization: Reject the local-direct interpretation if P-off restores nonlearned or remote inference.
cross_seed_decision.valid_failure: If omitted rescue fails in both fresh seeds under intact competence, reject cross-network confirmation of the simple lower-local-threshold account and revisit the subject evidence model without modifying frozen v2.4.
cross_seed_decision.competence_or_integrity_failure: The affected seed is non-interpretable; repair execution under the unchanged contract without replacement or scientific changes.

outcome_contingent_interpretation.all_links_confirm: The mechanism is supported on fresh blind backbones in addition to the characterized development networks. Freeze it as the current local/global main model, then address global distance dependence as a separate read-only P_T policy problem.
outcome_contingent_interpretation.mixed_between_seeds: Treat the failed links as implementation heterogeneity or unresolved generalization. Preserve all passing links and stop before Track B model changes; Track B may still proceed read-only because it concerns the frozen v1 P_T branch.
outcome_contingent_interpretation.retained_tradeoff_within_margin: Report the signed retained cost and uncertainty even when noninferiority passes; never describe retained decisions as literally unaffected.
outcome_contingent_interpretation.slope_unchanged_or_worse: Report it mandatorily but do not fail local evidence access; it remains the separate Track B question.
